name: run_display_setup_and_loop
description: Allocates memory and reads five timed values from a library call into a small array. It then draws several fixed rectangles and a looped set of blocks, waiting on a timer count between steps, and runs a final teardown branch only when a state word is zero. Library calls include exec AllocMem, AvailMem and FreeMem.

name: forward_fixed_address_call
description: Passes one fixed address constant to a routine and then makes a second call with no arguments. It has no other logic.

name: store_state_and_dispatch
description: Stores the incoming word into a state field and makes a fixed run of calls. It then calls one of two routines depending on whether that word is zero, with further calls gated by a second state word, and ends with a call through the global library base.

name: draw_block_between_library_calls
description: Brackets a single block draw with two calls to a library routine at offset minus 300. The block width is a stored word shifted left by three, the height is another stored word, and the block is drawn at the origin.

name: copy_fixed_table_into_buffer
description: Reads a count from a routine, allocates a buffer of that size through the global library base and stores its pointer. It then copies that many bytes from a fixed source table into the buffer, counting down.

name: pass_constant_then_library_call
description: Passes a fixed constant to one routine and then calls a library routine through the global base at offset minus 210. Nothing else happens.

name: free_nonzero_list_entries
description: Walks a pointer table backwards, with the count taken from a byte at the head of the structure, and calls exec FreeMem for each entry that is not null.

name: allocate_buffer_check_small_limit
description: Allocates a memory block through the global library base and stores its pointer, calling a fallback routine if the result is null. If a second query returns zero and the first value exceeds a small limit, it calls another routine; otherwise it sets a status word to one.

name: run_frame_animation_loop
description: Runs a timed animation of up to 108 frames. Each frame checks a helper result to exit early, clears a rectangle, draws a column of blocks from indexed tables, waits on a raster position counter, copies six pointers into display pointer locations and swaps two frame buffers. After the loop it draws a final rectangle, waits, updates the pointers again and calls two library routines.

name: allocate_buffer_check_large_limit
description: Allocates a memory block through the global library base and stores its pointer, calling a fallback routine if the result is null. If a second query returns zero and the first value exceeds a larger limit, it calls another routine; otherwise it sets a status word to one.

name: run_short_animation_loop
description: Runs a shorter timed animation of up to 50 frames with the same per-frame structure: a helper result can end it early, a rectangle is cleared, a block is drawn from indexed tables, the display waits on a raster counter and pointers are swapped. A final frame is then drawn with waits and two library calls.

name: draw_entry_table_frames
description: Prepares 22 position and size entries from a 16-word table, then loops over them. For each entry it updates a table of 32-bit values, draws a rectangle, waits on a raster counter and writes a group of six pointers to the display, drawing an extra block when the entry changes. It ends by setting two fixed words and making final library calls.

name: initialise_custom_chip_display
description: Calls a library routine, writes the DMA control and copper list pointer registers, copies a table of 15 words from a source table into a working area and clears a block of memory. It waits on a hardware status bit, sets the copper pointer from a library result and calls further library routines.

name: intro_bytekiller_depack
description: Unpacks a compressed stream by reading bits from its end and copying back-referenced runs backward into memory, then checks a checksum. If the checksum matches it clears a block of memory, initialises the display and sets the copper list pointer before returning; on a mismatch it writes a sequence of values to a global location and returns.

name: copy_table_then_indirect_call
description: If the pointer passed on the stack is non-null, copies 16 longwords from a fixed table into it. It then makes an indirect call through an address register and returns.

name: increment_counter_clear_bit
description: Library code that increments a 16-bit counter at offset 32 of a structure and clears bit 3 of the flag byte at offset 14 of the same structure. It returns nothing.

name: decrement_library_refcount
description: Library code that decrements the 16-bit counter at offset 32 of a structure. If the counter reaches zero and bit 3 of the flag byte at offset 14 is set, it calls another routine and returns its result; otherwise it returns zero.

name: unlink_node_or_mark_pending
description: Library code that, when the word at offset 8 is zero, unlinks the node from its list and calls a library routine at offset minus 210 with the value at offset 42, returning that result. Otherwise it sets bit 3 of the flag byte at offset 14 and returns zero.

name: set_flag_bit_return_zero
description: Library code that sets bit 3 of the flag byte at offset 14 of a structure and returns zero.

name: store_result_alert_if_null
description: Library code that stores its two inputs into a structure, calls a library routine at offset minus 408 and keeps the result. If the result is zero it calls exec Alert through the global library base; otherwise it copies the two stored values into two global variables.

name: copy_struct_fields_to_globals
description: Library code that copies two 32-bit fields from a structure, at offsets 34 and 38, into two global variables and returns.

name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Library vector entry that does nothing except call one shared helper routine and then return. It adds no logic of its own.

name: store_argument_at_returned_pointer
description: Library code that calls a library routine at offset minus 294 with its first argument, then stores its second argument as a 32-bit value at offset 148 of the pointer that routine returns.

name: chain_calls_discard_on_failure
description: Library code that calls one routine with its last two arguments and, if the result is nonzero, calls a second routine with the first two arguments and that result. If the second call returns zero it calls a third routine to discard the result and returns zero; otherwise it returns the first result.

name: fill_record_from_buffer_fields
description: Library code that gets a record from one routine and fills a local buffer through a second routine. On success it copies ten longwords and eight further fields from that buffer into the record at fixed offsets, and if the field at offset 76 is set it stores the record pointer into the structure that field points to. It returns the record on success; on failure it calls another routine on the record and returns zero.

name: copy_stack_fields_into_record
description: Copies ten longwords and eight further fields from a buffer on the stack into a record at fixed offsets. If the field at offset 76 is set, it stores the record pointer into the structure that field points to. It returns nothing.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Empty library stub that does no work and returns zero.

name: copy_icon_data_to_stack
description: Copies ten longwords and several further fields from a record into a local array on the stack, writes two fixed header words beside them, then calls another routine with its first two arguments and a pointer to that header.

name: load_icon_record
description: Loads an icon record: builds a name in a 260-byte stack buffer, calls library routines to fetch the data, and checks a magic word and a version word in its header. It then reads sized data blocks into the record, obtaining memory for list blocks, and returns one on success or zero otherwise.

name: read_icon_record_blocks
description: Second half of icon record loading, calling library routines through a function pointer. It checks the magic word and version word, reads the optional data blocks and list entries into memory, and returns one on success or zero after any failure.

name: read_icon_record_tail_blocks
description: Continues icon record loading: stores two values read through a routine into the record, then reads an optional list of pointers and an optional further block through a function pointer. Returns one on success and zero on failure.

name: read_icon_pointer_list
description: Reads a null-terminated list of pointer entries through a function pointer, storing each entry and its size, then reads an optional trailing block. Returns one on success and zero on failure.

name: call_helper_return_zero
description: Calls one routine, discards its result and returns zero.

name: do_nothing_and_return
description: Empty routine that performs no work and returns immediately.

name: write_icon_record
description: Writes an icon record: builds a name in a 260-byte stack buffer, reports an error and returns zero if that fails, then writes the record's fields and optional blocks, each with its size, through library calls. It returns one on success, zero on failure, and releases the buffer at the end.

name: write_icon_record_tail
description: Continues icon record writing: writes the record's fields and optional list entries through a function pointer, each preceded by its size, then releases the temporary buffer and returns one on success or zero on failure.

name: write_icon_pointer_list
description: Writes an optional block, then a null-terminated list of pointer entries each with its size, then an optional trailing block, through a function pointer. Returns one on success and zero on failure.

name: write_icon_pointer_entries
description: Writes the entries of a null-terminated pointer list, each with its size, followed by an optional trailing block, then restores a saved field. Returns one on success and zero on failure.

name: write_pointer_table_entries
description: Writes the entries of a null-terminated pointer table from a given start, each with its size, followed by an optional trailing block. Returns one on success and zero on failure.

name: iterate_linked_list_nodes
description: Walks a list by calling a routine to get each next node, stopping at a null result or when the list head is reached, and calls another routine on each node. A final non-null node is passed to that routine too.

name: process_linked_list_nodes
description: Walks a linked list by passing each node to a routine and then fetching the next node through another routine. It stops when a fetched node is null or the link at offset 8 loops back to the start, and a final non-null node is also passed on.

name: forward_with_offset_argument
description: Calls another routine with its first argument unchanged and its second argument increased by 140, then returns.

name: allocate_and_init_record
description: Allocates a 168-byte cleared record through a routine and calls two routines that take fields of it. If the first check fails it releases the record; if the second fails it returns zero without releasing it; otherwise it returns the record.

name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Library entry that does nothing except pass control to a helper routine and then return.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Empty library stub that does no work and returns zero.

name: store_pair_refill_if_empty
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter held through a pointer. If the counter was zero or less, it first calls a routine to refill the table and returns zero on failure. It then stores two supplied longwords into the next pair of entries in a table pointed to by the structure and returns one.

name: decrement_counter_and_store_pair
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter through a pointer, then stores two longwords, taken from its arguments, into the next pair of entries in a table pointed to by the structure. It returns one.

name: allocate_record_with_checks
description: Allocates a 94-byte cleared record and calls routines on its fields. If the first two checks fail it releases the record; if the last step fails it calls another routine and returns zero; otherwise it returns the record.

name: do_nothing_and_return
description: Empty routine that performs no work and returns immediately.

name: call_library_routine_return_zero
description: Calls one library routine through the library base, discards its result and returns zero.

name: forward_with_offset_argument
description: Calls another routine with its first argument unchanged and its second argument increased by 78, then returns.

name: scan_list_for_equals_value
description: Scans a null-terminated list of strings, calling a routine on each entry until one passes and its text has an equals sign at the matching position. It returns a pointer to the text just after that equals sign, or zero when no entry matches.

name: find_text_after_equals
description: Scans a null-terminated list of strings, calling a routine on each entry until one passes and its text has an equals sign at the matching position. It returns a pointer to the text just after that equals sign, or zero when no entry matches.

name: find_text_after_equals
description: Scans a null-terminated list of strings, calling a routine on each entry until one passes and its text has an equals sign at the matching position. It returns a pointer to the text just after that equals sign, or zero when no entry matches.

name: match_delimited_token_in_string
description: Walks entries separated by a delimiter character (code 124) from a starting point, measuring each entry and checking whether its length matches an expected value and a comparison routine accepts it. Returns one on the first match and zero when the entries run out.

name: search_delimited_tokens_for_match
description: Walks entries separated by a delimiter character (code 124) from a starting point, measuring each entry and checking whether its length matches an expected value and a comparison routine accepts it. Returns one on the first match and zero when the entries run out.

name: search_delimited_tokens_for_match
description: Walks entries separated by a delimiter character (code 124) from a starting point, measuring each entry and checking whether its length matches an expected value and a comparison routine accepts it. Returns one on the first match and zero when the entries run out.

name: search_delimited_tokens_for_match
description: Walks entries separated by a delimiter character (code 124) from a starting point, measuring each entry and checking whether its length matches an expected value and a comparison routine accepts it. Returns one on the first match and zero when the entries run out.

name: search_delimited_tokens_for_match
description: Walks entries separated by a delimiter character (code 124) from a starting point, measuring each entry and checking whether its length matches an expected value and a comparison routine accepts it. Returns one on the first match and zero when the entries run out.

name: parse_copy_number_label
description: Parses a text string into a record and returns the record. It clears a byte at offset 30 and, if the text begins with a five-character marker, stores that marker and copies a 30-byte field. Otherwise it reads an optional three-character marker, then decimal digits and a four-character suffix, storing the number plus one before copying the 30-byte field.

name: check_copy_number_text
description: Parses the text at a fixed offset: it checks a three-character marker, reads decimal digits after it and checks a four-character suffix. It then makes two follow-up calls in every case and returns nothing.

name: parse_digits_then_check_suffix
description: Reads decimal digits from a text pointer and, if any were read, checks the following four characters against a fixed string. It makes two follow-up calls in every case and returns nothing.

name: parse_digits_then_check_suffix
description: Reads decimal digits from a text pointer and, if any were read, checks the following four characters against a fixed string. It makes two follow-up calls in every case and returns nothing.

name: digit_char_to_value
description: Converts a digit character to its numeric value from zero to nine, returning minus one for any other character.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Library stub that does no work and returns minus one.

name: chain_calls_discard_on_failure
description: Library code that calls one routine with its last two arguments and, if the result is nonzero, calls a second routine with the first two arguments and that result. If the second call returns zero it calls a third routine to discard the result and returns zero; otherwise it returns the first result.

name: allocate_record_with_count
description: Allocates a 96-byte cleared record, sets a count of 10 both in the record at offset 14 and in the caller's word, and calls a routine to fill in the record. It returns one if the allocation succeeded and zero otherwise.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Empty library stub that does no work and returns zero.

name: call_and_check_result
description: Calls a routine with its last three arguments and returns that result if it equals the last argument, or zero otherwise.

name: call_and_check_result
description: Calls a routine with its last three arguments and returns that result if it equals the last argument, or zero otherwise.

name: do_nothing_and_return
description: Empty routine that performs no work and returns immediately.

name: divide_32_bit_values
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor and returns the quotient and remainder. For divisors above 16 bits it shifts and subtracts bit by bit over sixteen steps; otherwise it divides the two 16-bit halves in turn.

name: divide_sixteen_bit_steps
description: Runs sixteen restoring-division steps on a 32-bit value, shifting one bit in at a time and subtracting the divisor whenever the partial remainder reaches it. It updates the working registers and returns nothing.

name: multiply_32_bit_integers
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values using 16-bit partial products and returns the low 32 bits of the product. It also returns the second operand with its two halves swapped.

name: call_raw_format_routine
description: Calls the exec RawDoFmt library routine through a function pointer in the global library data and returns.

name: compute_string_checksum
description: Walks a null-terminated string, decrementing the low 16 bits of a 32-bit accumulator for each character until the terminator or until that half underflows, then returns the bitwise complement of the accumulator.

name: find_char_in_string
description: Scans a null-terminated string for a given byte and returns a pointer to its first occurrence, or zero if it is not found before the terminator.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Empty library stub that does no work and returns zero.

name: copy_c_string
description: Copies a null-terminated string byte by byte from the source to the destination, including the terminator.

name: append_c_string
description: Finds the terminator of the destination string, then copies the source string onto its end, including the terminator.

name: compare_c_strings_limited
description: Compares two strings up to a given count of characters. It returns zero when they match over that range and one at the first difference.

name: return_one_stub
description: Library stub that does no work and returns one.

name: check_string_fits_limit
description: Steps through a null-terminated string for at most a given number of characters. When it finds the terminator within that limit it makes one follow-up call; otherwise it returns without making the call.

name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Library entry that does nothing except pass control to a helper routine and then return.

name: copy_string_pad_with_zeros
description: Copies a null-terminated string into a destination buffer of a given length, stopping at the terminator and then filling the remaining bytes with zeros.

name: setup_pointer_chain
description: Stores the address of a block as a longword, adds four to it, clears the following longword and stores the block address in the longword after that. It returns nothing.

name: validate_then_process_request
description: Returns one when the third argument is zero. Otherwise it checks the structure with a routine on its 20-byte header; if that passes it makes two further calls using a value read from the structure and returns the result of the last call. If the check fails it returns zero.

name: walk_list_checking_entries
description: Walks a linked list of entries, calling a routine on each entry's header and on its sized data block, and stops when a call fails. Returns one when the whole list is processed and zero otherwise.

name: walk_list_pairs_checked
description: Repeatedly makes two checking calls on the current list entry and advances to the next entry. It returns one when the list ends and zero as soon as a check fails.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Empty library stub that does no work and returns zero.

name: allocate_entry_record_checked
description: Allocates a 20-byte cleared record when its last argument is nonzero, runs several routines to fill it, and stores a result at offset 10. It returns the record on success, minus one on failure, and zero when the last argument is zero.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Library stub that does no work and returns minus one.

name: build_entry_list_from_blocks
description: Builds a linked list of entries: for each one it allocates a 16-byte cleared record, links it to the previous entry, obtains a data block sized from a byte in the record and stores it at offset 8. It returns the head of the list on success and minus one on failure.

name: build_linked_entry_chain
description: Builds a chain of entries from a source, storing each entry's data pointer at offset 8 and linking each entry to the next at offset 12. It returns the first entry when the chain is complete, or minus one on failure.

name: fill_entry_chain_nodes
description: Fills in a chain of entries that are linked at offset 12, storing a data pointer at offset 8 for each. It returns the head entry when the last link is reached, or minus one if any step fails.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Library stub that does no work and returns minus one.

name: dispatch_through_jump_table
description: Program entry stub that makes an indirect call through a jump table indexed by a global value. The decompiler could not recover the table, so the target is unknown, and the routine returns after the call.

name: open_library_and_dispatch
description: Prepares a table entry: when its stored value differs from a source value it updates the entry and calls library routines on the old items. It then opens a library and raises exec Alert if that fails. On success it runs a loop of two library calls that store results, then makes an indirect call through a table index.

name: build_command_line_and_run
description: Clears a block of memory with zero longwords, then opens a library and returns error code 100 if that fails. On success it fetches a message from the process port, builds a command line from the argument text with spaces between its parts and calls two routines with it. It then releases library resources and returns the status.

name: cleanup_close_and_reply
description: Cleanup routine: calls an optional hook if one is set, makes a library call, then if resources were opened it closes a library, forbids task switching and replies to the message. Returns a stored status value.

name: initialise_structure_fields
description: Sets five fields of a structure to fixed values: offsets 64, 66 and 102 to zero or 256 as appropriate, offset 84 to the address of a global variable, and offset 88 to a fixed constant.

name: build_bitmask_entries_from_table
description: Loops over a table of 16-bit values from its end to its start. For each positive value it sets a bit-mask word, and for each bit set in a flags byte it writes two pointers and a size into a structure, making helper calls around these updates.

name: build_bitmask_entries_from_table
description: Loops backward over a table of 16-bit values. For each positive value it sets a bit-mask word and, for each bit set in a flags byte, writes two pointers and a size into a structure, making helper calls around these updates. It returns the last size it computed.

name: do_nothing_and_return
description: Empty routine that performs no work and returns immediately.

name: fill_next_sequence_record
description: Fills in the next record of a sequence. When a counter equals four it first sets fixed field values, then it stores a pointer from a cursor and steps the counter down. While the counter is still nonnegative it sets a flag field from a flag bit, stores a value and a pointer, advances the cursor and returns one, making a library call when the counter is three. Once the counter runs out it makes helper calls and returns zero.

name: fill_next_sequence_record
description: Continues filling the next record of a sequence: stores the cursor, steps the counter down and, while it is still nonnegative, sets a flag field from a flag bit, stores a value and a pointer, advances the cursor and returns one. Otherwise it makes helper calls and returns zero.

name: store_sequence_record_fields
description: Sets a record's flag field to 18, stores a pointer and a value from the cursor, advances the cursor, and makes a library call when the counter is three. Returns one.

name: call_library_if_flag_set
description: If the flag value is nonzero, makes a library call at offset minus 426 through the library base, then returns one.

name: decrement_counter_and_return_zero
description: Makes a helper call, decrements a 16-bit counter, makes a further helper call if one of two saved values is nonzero, then makes two more calls and returns zero.

name: wait_until_flag_clear
description: Waits in a loop while bit 6 of the byte at offset 2 of the structure stays set, then returns.

name: fill_block_and_reset_state
description: Fills a block of memory with all-ones longwords, then sets one state word to all-ones and clears two state words.

name: store_word_and_clear_state
description: Stores a 16-bit value through a pointer and clears two state words.

name: mask_words_and_call_library
description: Returns zero when two state words are both zero. Otherwise it saves one word, ANDs four words from a source table with that mask into four output locations, makes a library call at offset minus 426 and returns its result.

name: mask_words_and_call_library
description: Ands four words from a source table with a saved mask word, writes the results to four output locations, then makes a library call at offset minus 426 and returns.

name: clear_and_fill_mask_table
description: Clears two rows of 16-bit table entries, sizing the second clearing loop from a counter. If a global flag is set it fills rows from a pattern word and changes the pattern for each entry, mirroring the fill in the opposite direction.

name: do_nothing_and_return
description: Empty routine that performs no work and returns immediately.

name: do_nothing_and_return
description: Empty routine that performs no work and returns immediately.

name: append_string_to_buffer
description: Appends a null-terminated string to a bounded output buffer one character at a time, calling a routine whenever no space remains for a character. Returns the length of the string.

name: format_text_into_buffer
description: Copies a format string into a bounded output buffer, counting the characters written. When it meets a percent sign it looks up the following character in a small table and calls the matching handler, which the decompiler could not fully recover. Returns the count of characters.

name: format_hex_digits_into_buffer
description: Converts a value into eight hexadecimal digit characters using a digit table and writes them into a buffer. It then copies the rest of a format string, calling handlers for percent-sign entries, and returns the total count.

name: format_hex_digits_into_buffer
description: Converts a value into eight hexadecimal digit characters using a digit table and writes them into a buffer. It then copies the rest of a format string, calling handlers for percent-sign entries, and returns the total count.

name: format_rest_of_string
description: Continues formatting: copies the remaining format string into the buffer, counting characters, and when it meets a percent sign calls the matching handler from a small table. Returns the total count.

name: format_rest_of_string
description: Copies a format string into the buffer, counting characters, and when it meets a percent sign calls the matching handler from a small table. Returns the total count.

name: write_stream_field_with_padding
description: Writes one field to an output stream. Depending on its flags it handles a single character or a string with width and padding, turns newline characters into carriage-return and newline pairs, copies characters into the output buffer, and records error or overflow conditions in a status byte.

name: read_stream_character
description: Reads the next character from an input buffer and returns it. A value of minus one marks the end-of-file character and sets a status bit, a carriage return is handled specially by reading the byte after it, and when the buffer runs dry a routine is called to refill it.

name: read_stream_character
description: Reads the next character from an input buffer and returns it. A value of minus one marks the end-of-file character and sets a status bit, a carriage return is handled specially by reading the byte after it, and when the buffer runs dry a routine is called to refill it.

name: report_failed_assertion
description: Formats an assertion failure message through a formatting routine, then makes a second call to report it.

name: uppercase_string_in_place
description: Converts each character of a null-terminated string to upper case in place, using a character class table to decide which characters are lower case letters.

name: append_bounded_string
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination buffer, copying at most a given count of characters, and terminates the result.

name: convert_integer_to_string
description: Converts an integer to decimal digit characters by repeatedly dividing, stores them in a temporary buffer, reverses them into the output and null-terminates the string. Returns the length.

name: convert_octal_to_string
description: Converts a value to a string of octal digits by repeatedly taking its low three bits, reverses the digits into the output, null-terminates the string and returns the length.

name: parse_decimal_integer
description: Parses an optional plus or minus sign and then decimal digits from a string into a 16-bit value stored at the given location. Returns the number of characters consumed.

name: append_byte_to_buffer
description: Stores one byte at the current position of an output buffer, then advances the position and a count.

name: format_into_string_buffer
description: Sets up a counted output buffer at the given address, runs a formatting routine on the stack arguments, terminates the string with a zero and returns the number of characters written.

name: advance_random_state
description: Advances a 15-bit pseudo-random state word with a linear congruential step: it multiplies by a fixed multiplier, adds three and masks the result to 15 bits.

name: store_random_seed
description: Stores a 16-bit value into the pseudo-random state word, seeding the generator.

name: open_channel_slot
description: Finds a free six-byte slot in a channel table, applies mode flags from its arguments and performs an initial transfer through helper routines. It records the slot number and result in the slot and returns the slot index, or minus one with an error code when no slot is free.

name: call_then_check_error
description: Calls one routine and returns minus one if it fails. Otherwise it calls a second routine and returns its result, or minus one when a status word shows an error.

name: allocate_from_free_list
description: Allocates a block of at least the requested size from a free list, rounding the size up to a multiple of four with a minimum of eight bytes. It splits a larger free block when the remainder is big enough; otherwise it asks for more memory through helper routines and returns zero if that fails. Returns the block address.

name: read_bytes_from_stream
description: Reads up to a given number of items of a given size from an input buffer into memory, one byte at a time, stopping early at an end marker. Returns the number of complete items read.

name: write_byte_to_channel
description: Writes one byte to an output buffer and counts it. When the buffer has no room left it calls a routine to handle the full buffer instead.

name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Stub that does nothing except call one helper routine and then return. It adds no logic of its own.

name: start_counted_output
description: Starts a counted output session: clears the character counter, saves the output stream pointer, runs a formatting routine on the stack arguments and makes a final call. Returns the count.

name: open_stream_with_mode
description: Opens a stream from a mode string whose first letter selects read, write or append, with an optional b or plus sign. It calls a routine to open the file and sets the stream's buffer fields and flags, and returns the stream or zero if the mode is invalid or the open fails.

name: flush_open_streams
description: Walks the list of open streams and, for each writable stream whose position differs from its saved position, calls a routine to write out its buffer. Then it makes one final call.

name: write_block_and_record_error
description: Writes a block to the output file through the DOS library. If the write fails it stores the DOS error code and sets a stream error of five. Returns the result of the write.

name: seek_stream_position
description: Seeks in the open file through the DOS library. If the seek fails it stores the DOS error code and sets a stream error of twenty-two. When the mode argument is two it performs a second seek.

name: read_block_from_file
description: Reads from the open file through the DOS library and returns the result. If the read fails it stores the DOS error code and sets a stream error of five.

name: open_file_by_name
description: Opens a file through the DOS library and returns the handle. If the open fails it stores the DOS error code, sets a stream error of two and returns minus one.

name: open_file_unless_locked
description: Tries to lock a file through the DOS library. If the lock succeeds it unlocks the file and returns minus one. If the lock fails it tries to open the file, and if that also fails it stores the DOS error code, sets a stream error of two and returns minus one; otherwise it returns the handle.

name: delete_locked_file_then_open
description: Locks a file through the DOS library and, if the lock succeeds, unlocks it and deletes it. It then opens the file through the DOS library, and if that fails it stores the DOS error code, sets a stream error of two and returns minus one.

name: close_file_return_zero
description: Closes the open file through the DOS library and returns zero.

name: compute_fixed_point_product
description: Multiplies two 32-bit fixed-point values, combining the cross products of their 16-bit halves into a 32-bit result.

name: divide_fixed_point_values
description: Divides one 32-bit fixed-point value by another, handling negative operands by negating the result. It normalises the divisor by shifting before the divide steps and shifts the result back.

name: normalize_fixed_point_divide
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor after normalising the divisor by shifting. Returns the quotient and remainder together as one 64-bit result.

name: lookup_table_entry_by_index
description: Looks up the six-byte entry at a given index in a table. It clears an error word, and if the index is out of range or the entry is unused it sets error nine and returns zero; otherwise it returns the entry's address.

name: free_all_list_entries
description: Walks a linked list, releasing each node through the exec FreeMem library call, then clears the list head and tail pointers and returns zero.

name: split_command_line_words
description: Splits a command line into words separated by spaces, tabs or newlines, treating double-quoted text as one word and ending each word with a zero byte. It stores pointers to up to 32 words in a table, selects the output mode and sets a handler hook, then makes two follow-up calls.

name: convert_hex_to_string
description: Converts a 32-bit value to a string of hexadecimal digits by repeatedly taking its low four bits, reverses the digits into the output, null-terminates the string and returns its length.

name: allocate_linked_node
description: Allocates a node with a 12-byte header and the requested data size through AllocMem, links it onto the end of a list, and returns the address after the header. Returns zero if allocation fails.

name: call_flagged_then_check_error
description: Gets a value from one routine and returns minus one if it is null. Otherwise it calls a second routine when a flag bit is set, makes a third call and returns its result, or minus one when a status word shows an error.

name: format_printf_style_argument
description: Processes one printf-style conversion: it reads flags, width, precision and length modifiers from the format text, fetches the next argument from the stack and emits the converted value through a character output routine, padded to the requested width. It handles character, string, decimal, unsigned, octal, hexadecimal and pointer conversions, and returns the position after the specifier or zero for an unknown conversion.
